Task description: Pick up the beveled block-shaped stamp on the left of the current view and stamp the brown square mark to its right and slightly below.

Success criteria: The stamp’s horizontal position is near the center of the brown square marker, and both grippers are open and have released it.

## Execution tips

- Grasp opposing flat upper-middle sidewalls, placing pads inside planar areas away from bevels and corners. Leave lower clearance for table contact to reduce slipping or fingertips reaching the table first.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the selected grasp area. Before closing, use a side view to confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides of the block, avoiding gripping only an edge or pushing the stamp over.
- When aligning to the mark, use both overhead and side views to judge the lower part of the stamp relative to the colored block, rather than mistaking the higher top surface's image position for the tabletop landing point.
- Descend slowly and vertically near the mark. Release only after the table securely supports the stamp, leaving clearance from the block during withdrawal to avoid shifting it by dragging.
